confidence_interval.warning: Independence assumption is weak -- there is model/scenario clustering, so this upper bound may be optimistic. The observed value (0/n) should also be reported descriptively.
confidence_interval.oracle_dependency: is_actually_dangerous() re-applies the gateway's own R1-R4 policy -- it is NOT an INDEPENDENT physical oracle. The result should be read as 'policy consistency', not as absolute proof of physical safety.
